title: Dragon Over Split Realms
description: A vertically split surreal landscape features a large detailed dragon with spread wings hovering at the top center, its body crossing the divide between a bright left side and a dark right side. On the left, a light-colored mountain range with a detailed castle, river, hiker with backpack and staff, and purple flowers under a bright sky; on the right, a dark mirrored version with a black castle, twisted river, and purple flowers under a starry night sky. A circular medallion with two faces sits at the center.
prompt: A vertically split surreal fantasy scene with a large gray dragon with spread bat-like wings flying across the top center. The left side shows a bright detailed mountain landscape with a castle, winding river, purple lavender flowers, and a hiker with backpack and staff standing on the path. The right side is a dark mirrored version with a black castle, twisted dark river, and purple flowers under a starry night. A circular medallion with two faces is centered between the realms. Intricate line art style with purple accents.
